reviews_5s:
Let’s be honest, this is a funnel.

It’s a translucent-y/opaque white color, nothing crazy

It’s easy to use, it’s not glamorous

The plastic isn’t crazy thick, but good enough that it feels like a semi-decent build quality, but nothing name brand-y.

But it does its job to reduce spills and help you get your fluid where you’re storing things.

Important note, it struggles with things like oats/flour/sugar, solid stuff tends to get caught, but it is obviously capable of doing liquidsPerfect for the small funnel.Well made. Good valueIf there was ever a funnel that could change your life, this $3.00 plastic vessel is the one.
